code_instructions.keep_code_dry: Keep your code DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself). If you find yourself writing the same code more than once, consider refactoring it into something shared with the common denominator.
code_instructions.no_comments_unless: No comments in code unless you need to explain why you needed to do something. You usually do not need to explain this
code_instructions.inverted_if: Use inverted if statements to reduce nesting where it improves readability and return to short circuit
code_instructions.no_variable_for_alias: Do not create variables that are just aliases for other variables
code_instructions.no_unnecessary_indirection: Don't add an extra layer of abstraction, function call, object, or wrapper that don’t actually improve the design, but rather makes the code harder to read, understand or change. You could go directly from A → B, but instead you go A → X → Y → Z → B for no real benefit.
